title: Influence of an average of functions
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, and let $I$ be a finite nonempty set of real-valued functions on the $q$-dimensional Boolean cube. For every coordinate $i$, the influence of coordinate $i$ in their pointwise average is at most the average of their influences in that coordinate.
